decisions.reason: The IMU sensor module was upgraded to its own product page in 2024, which signals active support within a modular sensor ecosystem that rarely retires components.
The industrial AC input module has its own page and a launch announcement, and it serves steady industrial automation demand at low maintenance cost.
The solid state relay module is a basic building block of the modular product line, and keeping it listed costs little even if sales are modest.
The RGB LED control module is a recent, cheap-to-maintain addition to the module catalog with steady hobbyist and industrial demand.
The wallbox remote access service supports the firm's growing EV charger business and adds customer value and recurring revenue.
